sheets.title: ELECTRICAL ONE-LINE DIAGRAM — LEGEND AND SYSTEMS DIAGRAM
sheets.reading_notes: One-line diagram for the Coastal Precast Systems HRBT plant at Cape Charles, VA. Source fed by a 1500 kVA utility transformer. Main distribution panel (MDP) is 800A/480V. Distribution branches to: WEST PNL (200A/480V), N EAST PNL (400A/480V), S EAST PNL (300A/480V), LTG PNL (100A/480V), XFMR QCP (100A to 75 kVA transformer → 240V QC Panel), L WELD #1 (250A), L WELD #2 (250A), EMON DMON METER (15A/480V energy monitoring). N EAST, S EAST, and WEST panels each feed a 25 kVA 480-240V transformer (RP1, RP2, RP3) with downstream 100A/240V panels. All equipment is Square D. Welding loads (LWELD #1, LWELD #2) are substantial (200A each). Energy/demand monitoring meter present. PDF text extracted; all data is from tabular input/output data sheets embedded in the report rather than visual drawing graphics.

gross_square_footage.notes: No area data on one-line diagram; area information not relevant to electrical study scope.

electrical: 800A main distribution panel (MDP), 480V, Square D, 22 kA interrupting rating
75 kVA transformer (XFMR QCP), 480V pri / 240V sec → 200A QC panel
Three 25 kVA transformers (XFMR RP1, RP2, RP3), 480V pri / 240V sec → 100A panels (PNL RP1, RP2, RP3)
All protective devices: Square D; all passed ANSI equipment evaluation
Arc flash levels: Level 0 (no PPE required) at 480V MDP/LTG/N EAST/S EAST panels; Level 3 (arc flash suit required) at 240V downstream panels and 480V WEST PNL
